ei.title: Gender Differences in Sports or Exercise Participation Among U.S. Adults

fullPassage: The graph above shows the share of adult men and women in the United States who reported engaging in sports or exercise at least occasionally from 2022 to 2023. Fitness, Aerobics, and Cardio were the top-ranked activities for women in terms of participation but were ranked fifth for men. For men, the most commonly reported activity among respondents was Basketball, followed by American Football/Flag Football, neither of which appeared on the list of activities for women. Hiking was one of the top three activities for both men and women, with a slightly higher percentage of women participating in it compared to men. Hunting/Fishing was ranked higher among men than women, and the participation rate for each gender was below 30%. Dancing, Swimming/Diving, Yoga/Pilates, and Running/Jogging appeared only on the women's list, with fewer than 30% of women reporting participation in each of these activities.
